assessment: This study presents a valuable finding on five genome-wide association study loci displaying discordant effects on T2D and abdominal obesity. The evidence supporting the claims of the authors is solid, although further experiments are required to describe the mechanisms through which a genetic variant can confer increased abdominal obesity while offering protection from T2D risk. The work will be of interest to researchers working within the fields of variant-to-function analysis and endocrinology.
